# KU100 HRIR attribution

`web/hrir/ku100-right25.json` is a derived/extracted representation of near-field HRIR data from:

J. M. Arend, A. Neidhardt, C. Pörschmann. *Spherical Near-Field (NF) HRIR Compilation of the Neumann KU100*. Zenodo, 2020.

https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4297951

Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).

The implementation path was informed by Saekisui's `binaural-voice` project:

https://github.com/Saekisui/binaural-voice

The upstream `binaural-voice` source code is MIT-licensed. The underlying HRIR dataset remains CC BY 4.0.

This project's public file contains a small representation used by the realtime Web Audio path; it does not replace the original dataset or its attribution requirements.
